interaction.folding.riding: Riding concept: the frame and wheels are shown unfolded. This schematic is not an operating instruction.
interaction.folding.folding: Folding concept: select this state to see the frame move into a more compact arrangement. Actual folding follows the released model manual.
interaction.folding.storing: Storage concept: the schematic shows the most compact of these three illustrative states. Final folded dimensions are not confirmed.
